description: Enables the Ctrl+P full-screen page search dialog in TmNotionEditor. Implement to search across pages and block content. All three methods are called depending on the search context.

methods.name: SearchPagesAsync
methods.description: Searches pages by title. Called when the user types in the search dialog.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Optional filter restricting which pages to include.

methods.name: SearchBlocksAsync
methods.description: Searches block content (full-text). Returns results with context snippets.

methods.name: SearchAllAsync
methods.description: Combined page + block search in a single call. Used to populate the main search results panel.

examples.title: Simple in-memory page search
